name: Start a claimed match
description: claimed -> running, on the token, and the lease reset to the row's own (soma-gate-renew-renew.sql says why it is what it is). The residency barrier the runner crosses before calling this is local to it and costs nothing at either end, which is why claim and start are two routes rather than one. Answers 409 rather than 404 when nothing moved: the row exists, the claim on it does not -- and telling a runner its claim is gone is the whole message.

with.name: The claim is gone
with.description: A stale token, a reaped lease, a revoked runner or a demoted owner -- one answer, because the runner's response to all four is identical: stop, and claim again.
